# RandomlyTools

> RandomlyTools is a fast, free, privacy-focused collection of browser-based random generators, calculators, cricket tools, and practical online utilities. Many tools are designed to run directly in the browser without requiring an account.

## Website

- [Homepage](https://randomlytools.in/) — Free online random generators, calculators, cricket tools, and practical utilities.

## Random Generators

- [Random Name Generator](https://randomlytools.in/random-name-generator/) — Generate random names for people, characters, writing, and creative projects.
- [Random Number Picker](https://randomlytools.in/random-number-picker/) — Pick random numbers within a chosen range.
- [Random Team Generator](https://randomlytools.in/random-team-generator/) — Randomly split a list of people into teams.
- [Random Country Generator](https://randomlytools.in/random-country-generator/) — Generate a random country for games, learning, travel inspiration, and creative activities.
- [Random Dog Name Generator](https://randomlytools.in/random-dog-name-generator/) — Generate dog name ideas.
- [Random Discord Name Generator](https://randomlytools.in/random-discord-name-generator/) — Generate Discord username and name ideas.
- [Random Shop Name Generator](https://randomlytools.in/random-shop-name-generator/) — Generate shop and business name ideas.
- [Random Restaurant Name Generator](https://randomlytools.in/random-restaurant-name-generator/) — Generate restaurant name ideas.
- [Random Japanese Name Generator](https://randomlytools.in/random-japanese-name-generator/) — Generate Japanese name ideas.
- [Random Instagram Username Generator](https://randomlytools.in/random-instagram-username-generator/) — Generate Instagram username ideas.
- [Random Coffee Shop Name Generator](https://randomlytools.in/random-coffee-shop-name-generator/) — Generate coffee shop name ideas.
- [Random Company & Brand Name Generator](https://randomlytools.in/random-company-brand-name-generator/) — Generate company and brand name ideas.

## Calculators & Practical Tools

- [Recipe Finder by Ingredients](https://randomlytools.in/recipe-finder-by-ingredients/) — Find recipe ideas based on available ingredients.
- [Attendance Calculator](https://randomlytools.in/attendance-calculator/) — Calculate attendance percentage and estimate attendance requirements.
- [AdSense Revenue Calculator](https://randomlytools.in/adsense-revenue-calculator/) — Estimate advertising revenue using traffic and RPM inputs.
- [Iceland Salary Calculator](https://randomlytools.in/iceland-salary-calculator/) — Estimate gross-to-net salary and take-home pay in Iceland.
- [Cyprus Salary Calculator](https://randomlytools.in/cyprus-salary-calculator/) — Estimate gross-to-net salary and take-home pay in Cyprus.
- [YouTube Money Calculator](https://randomlytools.in/youtube-money-calculator/) — Estimate YouTube earnings from views, RPM, and related inputs.
- [YouTube Money Calculator India](https://randomlytools.in/youtube-money-calculator-india/) — Estimate YouTube earnings for Indian audiences and RPM assumptions.
- [YouTube Money Calculator Iceland](https://randomlytools.in/youtube-money-calculator-iceland/) — Estimate YouTube earnings using Iceland-related RPM assumptions.
- [YouTube RPM Calculator](https://randomlytools.in/youtube-rpm-calculator/) — Calculate and estimate YouTube RPM.
- [YouTube Shorts Earnings Calculator](https://randomlytools.in/youtube-shorts-earnings-calculator/) — Estimate potential YouTube Shorts earnings.
- [Website Mockup Generator](https://randomlytools.in/website-mockup-generator/) — Create a website mockup for presentations, previews, and creative projects.
- [Fence Post Depth Calculator](https://randomlytools.in/fence-post-depth-calculator/) — Estimate fence post burial depth, post hole depth, concrete requirements, and total post length.
- [Pipe Size Calculator](https://randomlytools.in/pipe-size-calculator/) — Calculate pipe diameter, velocity, and flow from entered dimensions and units.
- [Percentage Calculator for Marks](https://randomlytools.in/percentage-calculator-for-marks/) — Calculate marks percentage, overall percentage, and target marks.
- [Download Pinterest Video from Link](https://randomlytools.in/download-pinterest-video-from-link/) — Check a public Pinterest Pin link and prepare the supported video download workflow.

## Cricket Tools

- [Cricket Qualification Calculator](https://randomlytools.in/cricket-qualification-calculator/) — Explore playoff qualification scenarios using points, remaining fixtures, and tie-break conditions.
- [Cricket NRR Calculator](https://randomlytools.in/cricket-nrr-calculator/) — Calculate cricket net run rate from runs and overs.
- [Cricket Required Run Rate Calculator](https://randomlytools.in/cricket-required-run-rate-calculator/) — Calculate the required run rate for a cricket chase.
- [Cricket Chase Calculator](https://randomlytools.in/cricket-chase-calculator/) — Calculate runs required, remaining balls, and required run rate during a chase.

## Articles & Guides

- [Articles](https://randomlytools.in/articles/) — Guides and practical articles related to RandomlyTools utilities.

## Pinterest Video Tool

The Pinterest video page is intended for public Pinterest Pin URLs. It does not request Pinterest passwords and does not bypass private, restricted, login-gated, or other access controls. Download or reuse media only when you have the necessary rights or permission.
